checks.description: at least one GPU node is Ready and advertises exactly one nvidia.com/gpu
checks.because: The NVIDIA device plugin (installed by Terraform) turns each GPU into a schedulable nvidia.com/gpu. One experiment is one pod holding one GPU, so the number of cells that run at once is the number of these lines.

checks.description: Kueue is installed with one research queue, a GPU quota, and two priorities (interactive above sweep-low)
checks.because: Terraform installs Kueue; the tests apply the queue (a cluster-wide GPU quota) and the two priority classes. A sweep is submitted at sweep-low so that a run somebody is waiting for goes ahead of the cells still queued.

checks.description: the run was admitted by Kueue and finished its three steps
checks.because: The run is an Indexed Job with a queue label. Kueue creates a Workload for it, checks the GPU quota and unsuspends the job; the pod is then scheduled onto a GPU node.

checks.description: the run's software is the pinned set (vLLM 0.33.0, TRL 1.18.2, transformers 5.24.0) and the engine got its fixed 8 GiB
checks.because: The pod runs the vLLM image and installs TRL and transformers at pinned versions. The engine's share of the GPU is computed from the card's size so that a 24 GB card and a 48 GB card lay a cell out alike.

checks.description: every step record carries the off-policy metrics, the version age and the live settings
checks.because: The run writes the design's metrics (ratio tail, effective sample size, behavior KL, clipped and masked fractions, age) with every optimizer step, together with the settings that were in force.
